name: docker-leviosa
description: Docker volume observability: size, contents, container dependencies and safe cleanup guidance.

scripts.//dev: Contracts are compiled once up front, then both apps start with their own pre-hooks skipped so two tsc processes cannot write shared/dist at the same time.
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && run-p dev:backend dev:frontend
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @leviosa/backend --ignore-scripts && npm run build --workspace @leviosa/frontend --ignore-scripts
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
